signal: LiveSwitch is rolling out a new suite of AI functionality for its instant-video platform serving field-service and restoration businesses

email.body1:
James, saw LiveSwitch readying a new suite of AI functionality on top of your instant-video platform for field-service teams.

A fresh capability usually means more service businesses worth reaching than the team can cover, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for LiveSwitch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
James, quick follow-up for LiveSwitch.

Shipping new AI features usually means pipeline targets climb faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings LiveSwitch needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
James, last bit of proof for LiveSwitch.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how LiveSwitch's reply rate likely compares to peer SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
James, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Rolling out new AI features is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to LiveSwitch's motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
